title: Randomized two-query constant-string tester
statement: For $n>0$, define a randomized nonadaptive tester for Boolean strings of length $n$ by choosing an ordered pair of indices independently and uniformly from the $n$ positions, querying the bits at those indices, and applying the all-equal transcript acceptance predicate to the resulting transcript.
